notes: Zone 2 refers to the park and the units next to the park.
No parking is allowed in any front yard.
All units in Zone 1 must have garages; at least 30% of units in Zone 2 must have garages.
Zone 1 may have no exterior stairways.
No vehicle access is allowed to the public space, and the site must have vehicle access to both Westgrove Drive and Addison Road.
Any fence along the public space must provide an open view.
The plat must dedicate 3.265 acres (Tract II) to the Town for park purposes, plus 12 feet of right-of-way for Addison Road.
Landscaping must screen the air conditioning units that face the public space.
